notes: Hong Kong's styles (hk-hongkong, M4) on china-south: public housing blocks (estate: pastel paint with colour accents, small paired windows, AC boxes), private tiled towers (apartment: bay windows, AC boxes), tong lau and walk-ups (tonglau: balconies at every floor, soot, shops and signboards), composite buildings (composite: the same over shops, smaller windows, more AC boxes), flatted factories (industrial: ribbon windows, concrete spandrels, roller shutters), colonial civic buildings (colonial: stone, cornice, a verandah arcade). Their wall detail is in the 'bays' slot (drawn where the bays are resolved) from the pattern library: estateAccents, bayWindows, shophouseBalconies, ribbonSpandrels, verandahArcade; the shops' signboards are the core shopfront's boards with letters. china-south's glass, commercial (malls and podiums), civic, factory, village (Sai Kung's village houses) and the landmark skins are kept as they are.
